isomorphic-git 1.38.6 — third-party notices
================================================

This distribution includes the self-contained browser bundle published by
isomorphic-git. The upstream source and build scripts for the exact release are:
https://github.com/isomorphic-git/isomorphic-git/tree/v1.38.6

The bundle contains the following runtime packages. Package names are taken
from the bundle source map and audited against the 1.38.6 package metadata.

MIT:
  async-lock, available-typed-arrays, base64-js, buffer, call-bind,
  call-bind-apply-helpers, call-bound, define-data-property, diff3,
  dunder-proto, es-define-property, es-errors, es-object-atoms, for-each,
  function-bind, get-intrinsic, get-proto, gopd, has-property-descriptors,
  has-symbols, has-tostringtag, hasown, ignore, is-callable, is-typed-array,
  isarray, math-intrinsics, minimisted, pako, pify,
  possible-typed-array-names, readable-stream, safe-buffer,
  set-function-length, sha.js, simple-get, to-buffer, typed-array-buffer,
  which-typed-array, and isomorphic-git itself.

Apache-2.0:
  clean-git-ref, crc-32. The complete license is in APACHE-2.0.txt.

BSD-3-Clause:
  ieee754; portions of sha.js derived from Paul Johnston's implementation.
  Their complete notices are in IEEE754-LICENSE and SHAJS-LICENSE.

ISC:
  inherits.

MIT AND Zlib:
  pako. Its complete notice is in PAKO-LICENSE.

LGPL-3.0-or-later:
  A modified `path.join` implementation copied from @zenfs/core/path by
  isomorphic-git. The legal header is preserved in
  index.umd.min.js.LICENSE.txt. The LGPL is in LGPL-3.0.txt and ZenFS's
  supplemental permission is in ZENFS-COPYING.md. The exact corresponding
  modified source is available at the isomorphic-git v1.38.6 source link
  above. Users of an unpacked peerd extension may replace/relink the vendored
  UMD file with a compatible build.

The standard MIT grant for isomorphic-git is reproduced in LICENSE.md. The
same grant applies to the MIT packages above; package-specific notices that
carry additional attribution are reproduced in the sibling license files.
